# Language Creation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageCreation`](gmeow-LanguageCreation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageCreation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The activity of creating or generating a language — a conlanger's design work or an AI model's generation run. Linked to its product by [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) (the language → activity) and to its agent by [`gmeow:wasAssociatedWith`](../properties/gmeow-wasAssociatedWith.md); the language is ascribed to its creator with [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) (a [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) for an AI-generated language).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)
